pli-tv-kd7:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena tiṃsamattā Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū sabbe āraññakā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā Sāvatthiṃ gacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upakaṭṭhāya vassūpanāyikāya nāsakkhiṃsu Sāvatthiyaṃ vassūpanāyikaṃ sambhāvetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.4: te ukkaṇṭhitarūpā vassaṃ vasiṃsu: āsanneva no bhagavā viharati ito chasu yojanesu na ca mayaṃ labhāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena katāya pavāraṇāya deve vassante udakasaṃgahe udakacikkhalle okapuṇṇehi cīvarehi kilantarūpā
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.6: yena Sāvatthi Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.1: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.2: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.4: kacci samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.6: samaggā ca mayaṃ bhante sammodamānā avivadamānā vassaṃ vasimhā na ca piṇḍakena kilamimhā.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.7: idha mayaṃ bhante tiṃsamattā Pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū Sāvatthiṃ āgacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upakaṭṭhāya vassūpanāyikāya nāsakkhimhā Sāvatthiyaṃ vassūpanāyikaṃ sambhāvetuṃ, antarā magge Sākete vassaṃ upagacchimhā.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.8: te mayaṃ bhante ukkaṇṭhitarūpā vassaṃ vasimhā:
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.9: āsanneva no bhagavā viharati ito chasu yojanesu na ca mayaṃ labhāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.10: atha kho mayaṃ bhante vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena katāya pavāraṇāya deve vassante udakasaṃgahe udakacikkhalle okapuṇṇehi cīvarehi kilantarūpā addhānaṃ āgatā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.2: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassaṃ vutthānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.4: anāmantacāro asamādānacāro gaṇabhojanaṃ yāvadatthacīvaraṃ yo ca tattha cīvaruppādo so nesaṃ bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.5: atthatakaṭhinānaṃ vo bhikkhave imāni pañca kappissanti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.6: evañ ca pana bhikkhave kaṭhinaṃ attharitabbaṃ: ||3||
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.4: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho imaṃ kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyya kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.8: saṃgho imaṃ kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno deti kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.9: yassāyasmato khamati imassa kaṭhinadussassa itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dānaṃ kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.11: dinnaṃ idaṃ saṃghena kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.12: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ, evaṃ anatthataṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.2: kathañ ca bhikkhave anatthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.21: na aññatra saṃghāṭiya atth. h. k.,
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.22: na aññatra uttarāsaṅgena atth. h. k.,
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.23: na aññatra antaravāsakena atth. h. k.,
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.24: na aññatra pañcakena vā atirekapañcakena vā tadah' eva sañchinnena samaṇḍalīkatena atth. h. k.,
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.25: na aññatra puggalassa atthārā atth. h. kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.26: sammā c' eva atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ tañ ce nissīmaṭṭho anumodati evam pi anatthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.27: evaṃ kho bhikkhave anatthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. ||5||
pli-tv-kd7:1.6.1: kathañ ca bhikkhave atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.

pli-tv-kd7:1.6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd7:1.7.1: kathañ ca bhikkhave ubbhataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.7.2: aṭṭh' imā bhikkhave mātikā kaṭhinassa ubbhārāya
pli-tv-kd7:1.7.3: pakkamanantikā niṭṭhānantikā sanniṭṭhānantikā nāsanantikā savanantikā āsāvacchedikā sīmātikkantikā sahubbhārā 'ti. ||7||1||

pli-tv-kd7:11.1.1: bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino disaṃgamiko pakkamati cīvarapaṭivisaṃ apacinayamāno,
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.2: tam enaṃ disaṃgataṃ bhikkhū pucchanti: kahaṃ tvaṃ āvuso vassaṃ vuttho kattha ca te cīvarapaṭiviso 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.3: so evaṃ vadeti: amukasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ vuttho 'mhi tattha ca me cīvarapaṭiviso ti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.4: te evaṃ vadanti: gacchāvuso taṃ cīvaraṃ āhara, mayan te idha cīvaraṃ karissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.5: so taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā bhikkhū pucchati: kahaṃ me āvuso cīvarapaṭiviso 'ti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.6: te evaṃ vadanti: ayan te āvuso cīvarapaṭiviso, kahaṃ gamissasīti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.7: so evaṃ vadeti: amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi tattha me bhikkhū cīvaraṃ karissantīti.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.8: te evaṃ vadanti: alaṃ āvuso mā agamāsi, mayan te idha cīvaraṃ karissāmā 'ti:
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.9: tassa evaṃ hoti: idh' ev' imaṃ cīvaraṃ kāressaṃ na paccessan ti,
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.15: bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino disaṃgamiko pakkamati --la-- tassa bhikkhuno nāsanantiko kaṭhinuddhāro. ||1|| bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino disaṃgamiko pakkamati cīvarapaṭivisaṃ apacinayamāno . . . ayan te āvuso cīvarapaṭiviso 'ti. so taṃ cīvaraṃ ādāya taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati, tam enaṃ antarā magge bhikkhū pucchanti: āvuso kahaṃ gamissasīti. so evaṃ vadeti: amukaṃ nāma āvāsaṃ gamissāmi, tattha me bhikkhū cīvaraṃ karissantīti. te evaṃ vadanti: alaṃ āvuso mā agamāsi, mayan te idha cīvaraṃ karissāmā 'ti. tassa evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.16: idh' ev' imaṃ cīvaraṃ kāressaṃ na paccessan ti, so taṃ cīvaraṃ kāreti. tassa bhikkhuno niṭṭhānantiko kaṭhinuddhāro . . . tassa evaṃ hoti: n' ev' imaṃ cīvaraṃ kāressaṃ na paccessan ti. tassa bhikkhuno sanniṭṭhānantiko kaṭhinuddhāro . . . idh' ev' imaṃ cīvaraṃ kāressaṃ na paccessan ti,
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.17: so taṃ cīvaraṃ kāreti, tassa taṃ cīvaram kayiramānaṃ nassati.

pli-tv-kd7:13.1.1: dve 'me bhikkhave kaṭhinassa palibodhā dve apalibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.2: katame ca bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa palibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vassati vātasmiṃ āvāse sāpekkho vā pakkamati paccessan ti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ akataṃ vā hoti vippakataṃ vā cīvarāsā vā anupacchinnā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.10: ime kho bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa palibodhā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.1: katame ca bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa apalibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.3: bhikkhave kathañ ca bhikkhave āvāsāpalibodho hoti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pakkamati tamhā āvāsā cattena vantena muttena anape kkhena na paccessan ti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.9: ime kho bhikkhave dve kaṭhinassa apalibodhā 'ti. ||2||13|| kaṭhinakkhandhakaṃ sattamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthu doḷasa, peyyālamukhāni
